'''Callin''' was a subscriber to, and commenter on, ''[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Callin commented on the deficiencies of the [[A2 Accounting/Business Unit]] when used by smaller businesses.
